from itertools import product
import hashlib

MAX_N = 12
checked = 0
positive_a = 0
boundary_a0 = 0

def req(x, msg):
    if not x:
        raise AssertionError(msg)

for n in range(2, MAX_N + 1):
  for r in range(1, n + 1):
    for s in range(1, n + 1):
      for t in range(1, min(r,s) + 1):
        if not (t > r + s - n):
          continue
        q = n-r
        rv, sv, tv = q, n-s, q-s+t
        # original and transformed bigrassmannian conditions
        req(1 <= t <= r and t <= s <= n, 'original')
        req(t > r+s-n, 'original strict')
        req(1 <= tv <= rv and tv <= sv <= n, ('conjugate',n,r,s,t))
        req(tv > rv+sv-n, ('conjugate strict',n,r,s,t))
        i, j = s-t+1, r-t+1
        a, b = min(q-i, r-j), min(i,j)
        iv, jv = sv-tv+1, rv-tv+1
        av, bv = min(n-rv-iv, rv-jv), min(iv,jv)
        req((iv,jv,av,bv)==(j,i,a,b), ('parameters',n,r,s,t))
        # four named shapes: (width,height), core containment, ambient box
        shapes = [
          ('orig-core', i,j, i,j, q,r),
          ('orig-lower', i, j+a, i,j, q,r),
          ('orig-right', i+a, j, i,j, q,r),
          ('conj-core', j,i, j,i, r,q),
          ('conj-lower', j, i+a, j,i, r,q),
          ('conj-right', j+a, i, j,i, r,q),
        ]
        for name,w,h,cw,ch,W,H in shapes:
          req(w <= W and h <= H, (name,n,r,s,t))
          req(cw <= w and ch <= h, ('core',name,n,r,s,t))
        if a >= 1:
          positive_a += 1
          for N in range(1,a*b+1):
            for tup in [(n,r,i,j,a,b,N),(n,rv,iv,jv,av,bv,N)]:
              nn,rr,ii,jj,aa,bb,NN=tup
              req(all(z >= 1 for z in tup), ('positive',tup))
              req(rr < nn and aa+jj <= rr and aa+ii <= nn-rr and bb <= ii and bb <= jj and NN <= aa*bb, ('valid',tup))
        else:
          boundary_a0 += 1
          req(a == 0 and ((i==q) or (j==r)), ('a0',n,r,s,t))
          req((i,j+a)==(i,j) and (i+a,j)==(i,j), ('orig singleton',n,r,s,t))
          req((j,i+a)==(j,i) and (j+a,i)==(j,i), ('conj singleton',n,r,s,t))
          req(not any(1 <= N <= a*b for N in range(1,2)), ('no N',n,r,s,t))
        checked += 1
print('INPUT max_n=%d' % MAX_N)
print('CHECKED bigrassmannian_tuples=%d positive_a=%d a0_boundary=%d' % (checked,positive_a,boundary_a0))
print('RESULT PASS all asserted inequalities and boundary identities hold in this finite range')
